description:
**Job Description – Proposal Engineer (Water & Wastewater Treatment)**

**Job Title:** Proposal Engineer – WTP / STP / ETP / RO / UF

**Location:** Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Experience:** 2–5 Years

**Department:** Proposal & Engineering / Technical Sales

**Industry:** Water Treatment / Wastewater Treatment / Environmental Engineering

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a technically skilled and detail-oriented **Proposal Engineer** with experience in water and wastewater treatment projects, including Water Treatment Plants (WTP), Sewage Treatment Plants (STP), Effluent Treatment Plants (ETP), Reverse Osmosis (RO), Ultrafiltration (UF), and desalination systems.

The candidate will be responsible for preparing technical and commercial proposals, reviewing customer enquiries, understanding project requirements, conducting equipment sizing and cost estimations, and coordinating with engineering, procurement, sales, and project execution teams.

The ideal candidate should have a good understanding of water treatment technologies, process equipment, tendering, costing, and technical documentation.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Technical Proposal Preparation**

* Review customer enquiries, tender documents, technical specifications, and project requirements.
* Prepare technical and commercial proposals for WTP, STP, ETP, RO, UF, MBR, and desalination projects.
* Develop preliminary process schemes, equipment lists, and technical specifications.
* Prepare technical datasheets, Bill of Quantities (BOQ), and Bill of Materials (BOM).
* Coordinate the preparation of Process Flow Diagrams (PFDs), Piping & Instrumentation Diagrams (P&IDs), and preliminary plant layouts.
* Prepare technical clarifications, deviations, and compliance statements based on tender requirements.

**2. Cost Estimation & Commercial Proposals**

* Prepare detailed cost estimates for water and wastewater treatment systems.
* Estimate costs for pumps, blowers, filters, membranes, pressure vessels, tanks, piping, valves, instrumentation, and other equipment.
* Obtain and evaluate quotations from vendors and suppliers.
* Prepare cost sheets, pricing summaries, and commercial offers.
* Coordinate with procurement and engineering teams to optimise project costs.
* Support commercial negotiations and proposal revisions.

**3. Tendering & Bid Management**

* Analyse RFQs, RFPs, tender documents, and client specifications.
* Prepare tender submissions in accordance with customer requirements.
* Ensure timely submission of technical and commercial bids.
* Maintain tender documentation, proposal records, and bid trackers.
* Prepare responses to technical queries and clarifications from clients and consultants.
* Support the sales team during technical discussions and pre-bid meetings.

**4. Process & Equipment Engineering**

* Assist in preliminary equipment sizing and selection for water treatment systems.
* Understand treatment processes such as clarification, filtration, biological treatment, membrane filtration, RO, UF, and chemical dosing.
* Review process design inputs, hydraulic requirements, and equipment specifications.
* Coordinate with process, mechanical, piping, electrical, and instrumentation teams.
* Ensure proposed equipment and systems comply with technical specifications and project requirements.

**5. Engineering & Sales Coordination**

* Coordinate with sales, engineering, procurement, and project execution teams.
* Liaise with vendors and suppliers for technical quotations and equipment specifications.
* Support technical presentations and discussions with customers.
* Assist in proposal handover to the project execution team after order confirmation.
* Maintain accurate proposal documentation and revision records.

Required Skills

* Good understanding of water and wastewater treatment processes.
* Experience in preparing technical and commercial proposals.
* Knowledge of WTP, STP, ETP, RO, UF, and membrane treatment technologies.
* Experience in BOQ, BOM, equipment costing, and project estimation.
* Ability to read and interpret PFDs, P&IDs, GA drawings, and technical specifications.
* Knowledge of pumps, blowers, filters, membranes, piping, valves, and instrumentation.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
* Working knowledge of AutoCAD will be an added advantage.
* Strong analytical, communication, and coordination skills.
* Ability to manage multiple proposals and meet tender deadlines.

Educational Qualifications

* B.E. / B.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Environmental Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Diploma holders with relevant water treatment proposal experience may also be considered.

Experience Requirements

* **2–5 years of experience** in technical proposals, tendering, estimation, or application engineering.
* Relevant experience in water treatment, wastewater treatment, environmental engineering, or EPC projects.
* Hands-on experience in technical bid preparation, equipment costing, and commercial proposals is preferred.
* Candidates from water treatment equipment manufacturers, environmental engineering companies, and EPC contractors will be preferred.

Preferred Candidate Profile

We are looking for a technically competent Proposal Engineer who can independently review enquiries, prepare technical and commercial offers, coordinate with vendors, and support the sales team in securing projects.

The candidate should have practical knowledge of water and wastewater treatment technologies, equipment selection, proposal preparation, and project costing.

Pay: ₹20,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Work Location: In person

description:
Title
  
Solutions Consultant (Pre-Sales) - Enterprise SaaS Demos

Job ID
  
#JOL-SLE-IN-101326

Location
  
Chennai, Tamil Nadu, IN

**Summary**
  
Jolly Technologies is a Silicon Valley-based software company with more than 40,000 customers and millions of users, including many Fortune 500 companies and other world-renowned organizations.

Our products are B2B enterprise, multi-tenant, cloud-hosted SaaS platforms used by organizations with demanding business, security, and IT requirements across North America, Europe, Australia, and worldwide. Depending on business needs, you may work on one or more of our products.

We are looking for a technically fluent **Solutions Consultant** to conduct live product demonstrations for prospective customers in North America, Europe, Australia, and worldwide. You will run discovery with business stakeholders, tailor demos to their requirements, and confidently handle in-depth technical questions from their IT, security, and compliance teams across a wide range of enterprise topics.

**Working Hours (US Shift)**
  
Fully remote, work-from-home contract position. Our customer demos take place between 6:00 AM and 2:00 PM US Pacific Time. **You must be available approximately 7:30 PM - 3:30 AM IST on weekdays** (one hour earlier, 6:30 PM - 2:30 AM IST, during US daylight saving time).

**Responsibilities**
  

* Conduct live online demonstrations of our SaaS platforms for prospective enterprise customers
* Run discovery calls to understand business workflows, IT requirements, and decision criteria, and tailor each demo accordingly
* Answer in-depth technical questions from customer IT, security, and compliance teams on topics such as identity and access management (SSO, user provisioning, role-based access), APIs and webhooks, third-party integrations, data security and encryption, privacy and compliance frameworks (e.g., SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR), data residency and retention, hosting, availability, and disaster recovery, network and firewall requirements, mobile apps and device management, data import and export, audit logging, and multi-tenant architecture
* Assist with security questionnaires, RFPs, and technical requirement checklists
* Set up and configure trial accounts and proofs of concept to match customer scenarios
* Work with the sales team on deal strategy and next steps
* Share customer feedback, feature requests, and product gaps with the product and engineering teams
* Answer product questions from prospective and existing customers by email

**Requirements**
  

* Bachelor's degree, preferably in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related field
* 3+ years in pre-sales, solutions consulting, sales engineering, implementation, or technical account management for B2B SaaS or enterprise software
* Proven experience giving live software demonstrations to both business and IT audiences, ideally to international customers
* Strong working knowledge of enterprise IT and cloud SaaS architecture, including identity and access management (e.g., SAML/OIDC, SCIM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta), REST APIs and webhooks, integration patterns, data security and encryption, compliance frameworks, and cloud hosting concepts
* Able to quickly learn new technical areas and research accurate answers to questions you have not seen before
* Comfortable reading API documentation and working with tools such as Postman and JSON (writing production code is not required)
* Excellent spoken and written English
* Professional, organized, self-motivated, and customer-focused
* Strong references from previous managers

**Important**
  
This is a technical, customer-facing pre-sales role. You will not write code, but you must be comfortable leading technical conversations with enterprise IT teams. If your demo experience is mainly with consumer products or services, or your background is primarily in call-center or BPO work, this role is not a fit.

**Compensation**
  
₹22,00,000 - ₹32,00,000 per year (commensurate with experience)

**Application Process**
  

* Reply with your resume (PDF or Word) to **jobs.2026 @ jollytech.com** with subject “JOL-SLE-IN-101326”
* Include your desired salary
* Include 3-5 concise bullet points describing the software products you have demonstrated and to whom
* **Include a link to a 2-3 minute video** (Loom, unlisted YouTube, Google Drive, etc.) in which you explain an enterprise technical concept of your choice to a customer's IT manager (for example, how single sign-on works, how a REST API integration works, or how customer data is kept separate in a multi-tenant SaaS platform). Applications without a video will not be considered.

description:
Roles & Responsibilities  
I. Lead Planning, Management & Execution

* Handle inbound customer enquiries generated through digital marketing campaigns, property portals, website enquiries, social media, referrals, walk-ins, channel partners, and other approved lead sources.
* Execute outbound calling to assigned customer databases and prospective buyers using the company's CRM and lead management systems.
* Understand and record customer requirements, including budget, preferred location, plot size, investment purpose, purchase timeline, and payment preferences.
* Introduce the company's plotted development projects and identify prospects with genuine purchase interest.
* Classify and prioritise leads as Hot, Warm, or Cold based on customer interest, budget, purchase readiness, and follow-up requirements.
* Ensure timely and accurate updates of lead status, call outcomes, customer requirements, and next follow-up dates in the CRM.
* Prioritise high-potential leads and ensure that genuine customer enquiries receive timely attention.
* Reconnect with inactive and previously interested leads to identify potential sales opportunities.

II. Customer Engagement & Project Explanation

* Act as the first point of contact for prospective customers interested in purchasing residential plots.
* Explain the company's plotted development projects, including project location, connectivity, available plot sizes, layout details, amenities, infrastructure, and other key features.
* Provide accurate and updated information regarding plot pricing, availability, approved offers, payment plans, and booking procedures.
* Understand customer requirements and communicate suitable project options based on their budget, location preference, and intended use.
* Address customer queries professionally through telephone calls, WhatsApp, emails, and other company-approved communication channels.
* Share approved project brochures, location maps, presentations, videos, and other marketing materials with prospective customers.
* Handle common customer objections relating to pricing, location, accessibility, plot availability, payment terms, and purchase timelines.
* Escalate technical, legal, documentation, approval-related, or pricing queries to the appropriate internal team whenever necessary.
* Ensure all information shared with customers is accurate, transparent, and consistent with company-approved communication.
* Build customer trust through professional communication, timely responses, and consistent follow-ups.

III. Lead Qualification, Follow-Up & Sales Pipeline Management

* Qualify leads based on customer interest, budget suitability, preferred project location, purchase readiness, and willingness to attend a site visit.
* Identify genuine prospective plot buyers and distinguish them from general enquiries or prospects with no immediate purchase intent.
* Maintain a systematic follow-up schedule for interested customers and ensure that no qualified lead is missed due to delayed communication.
* Follow up with customers who require additional information, need time to discuss with family members, or are comparing different property options.
* Record customer objections, feedback, purchase timelines, and agreed next steps in the CRM.
* Re-engage older leads and prospects who previously showed interest but did not proceed with a site visit or booking.
* Share qualified leads and relevant customer information with the Field Sales Team to support effective customer engagement.
* Monitor the progress of leads from initial enquiry through qualification, site-visit scheduling, and subsequent sales follow-up.
* Maintain an updated pipeline of active prospects, follow-up cases, and potential sales opportunities.

IV. Site-Visit Coordination & Conversion Support

* Convert qualified customer enquiries into confirmed site visits for the company's plotted development projects.
* Explain the importance of visiting the project site to understand the actual location, layout, accessibility, surrounding development, and available plots.
* Schedule site visits based on customer availability and coordinate with the Sales Managers, Field Sales Executives, and Site Teams.
* Confirm scheduled visits with customers and provide reminders to improve attendance.
* Share customer requirements, budget details, preferred plot sizes, and previous discussion notes with the assigned Sales Executive before the site visit.
* Track scheduled, completed, rescheduled, and cancelled site visits in the CRM.
* Follow up with customers after their site visits to understand feedback, interest level, concerns, and further requirements.
* Coordinate with the Sales Team to identify prospects who require additional assistance before proceeding towards booking.
* Support the sales team in improving lead-to-site-visit and site-visit-to-booking conversion ratios.
* Maintain regular communication with the Sales Team regarding high-potential leads and immediate sales opportunities.

V. Channel Partner Coordination (If Applicable)

* Coordinate with the Channel Partner Team or designated reporting manager regarding enquiries received through channel partners and property brokers.
* Record and track customer leads referred by channel partners in the prescribed CRM system.
* Ensure that channel partner leads are assigned, updated, and followed up on according to company procedures.
* Coordinate with the concerned internal team to obtain approved information regarding project details, pricing, availability, and sales processes for channel partner enquiries.
* Follow up on referred leads and coordinate with the Sales Team regarding site visits and subsequent sales progress.
* Maintain proper records of channel partner enquiries, lead status, site visits, and booking updates.
* Escalate channel partner-related queries or issues to the authorised team for resolution.
* Follow company policies concerning lead ownership, customer allocation, channel partner communication, and commission-related information.

VI. Target Achievement & Performance Delivery

* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly performance targets assigned by the reporting manager.
* Meet prescribed outbound calling and customer enquiry-handling targets.
* Maintain expected productivity in terms of connected calls, meaningful customer conversations, and qualified leads.
* Generate and schedule qualified site visits based on customer interest and project requirements.
* Improve site-visit attendance through timely confirmation calls, reminders, and follow-ups.
* Contribute to sales and booking objectives by providing qualified prospects and consistent follow-up support to the Field Sales Team.
* Monitor individual performance against assigned targets and take corrective action when required.
* Participate in daily reviews, weekly performance meetings, and monthly target assessments.
* Maintain a balance between calling volume, lead quality, customer experience, and conversion performance.
* Work towards the performance benchmarks established by management based on lead availability, campaign volume, and project requirements.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs):**

* Number of outbound calls made.
* Number of inbound enquiries handled.
* Number of connected calls and meaningful conversations.
* Number of qualified leads generated.
* Number of site visits scheduled and completed.
* Site-visit attendance and conversion rates.
* Follow-up completion and lead reactivation.
* CRM data accuracy and timely MIS submission.
* Contribution to sales opportunities and bookings.

VII. CRM, Documentation & MIS Reporting

* Maintain complete and accurate customer records in the company's prescribed CRM or lead management system.
* Update call outcomes, customer requirements, lead classification, follow-up dates, site-visit schedules, and sales progress promptly.
* Ensure proper lead allocation, status updates, and follow-up tracking in accordance with company procedures.
* Prepare and submit daily call reports, follow-up reports, qualified-lead reports, and site-visit updates.
* Prepare weekly lead pipeline and site-visit status reports for management review.
* Support the preparation of monthly performance reports covering productivity, lead conversion, site visits, and sales contribution.
* Maintain transparency and accuracy in all CRM entries, reports, and customer-related documentation.
* Avoid duplicate records, incomplete entries, and unauthorised changes to lead information.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer information, company databases, project pricing, and internal business information.
* Follow company guidelines for CRM usage, data security, and customer information handling.

VIII. Coordination with Internal Teams

* Coordinate with the Team Lead – Pre-Sales / Pre-Sales Manager for daily activities, target allocation, lead prioritisation, and performance reviews.
* Work closely with the Digital Marketing Team to understand lead sources, campaign details, and the quality of incoming enquiries.
* Coordinate with Sales Managers and Field Sales Executives to facilitate site visits and support sales conversion.
* Liaise with the CRM Team for clarification regarding customer documentation, registration processes, and post-booking procedures when required.
* Coordinate with the Liaison Team for authorised clarification regarding project approvals and documentation-related queries.
* Communicate recurring customer objections, feedback, pricing concerns, and market observations to the reporting manager.
* Participate in project briefings, product training, sales meetings, and internal performance reviews.
* Maintain effective communication and coordination across departments to ensure a smooth customer journey.

IX. Professional Development

* Develop a thorough understanding of the company's plotted development projects, including location, layout, plot sizes, amenities, pricing, and approved payment plans.
* Upgrade knowledge of CRM tools, lead management practices, customer engagement techniques, and sales reporting.
* Stay updated on real estate market trends, customer buying behaviour, competitor offerings, and local property demand.
* Improve telephone etiquette, persuasion, negotiation, objection handling, and customer relationship management skills.
* Participate in internal training programmes, project presentations, and performance improvement initiatives.
* Implement feedback received from the reporting manager to improve productivity and conversion performance.

X. Behaviour, Teamwork & Workplace Conduct

* Maintain professional conduct and a customer-focused approach in all interactions.
* Demonstrate discipline, ownership, accountability, and commitment to assigned targets.
* Work collaboratively with the Pre-Sales, Sales, Marketing, CRM, and other relevant teams.
* Maintain a positive attitude while handling customer objections, repeated follow-ups, and target-related pressure.
* Demonstrate patience, emotional intelligence, and effective communication when dealing with diverse customer requirements.
* Follow ethical sales practices and provide only accurate, company-approved information to customers.
* Adhere to company policies, attendance requirements, reporting procedures, and workplace guidelines.
* Maintain confidentiality of customer data and company information.
* Accept performance feedback positively and demonstrate continuous improvement in individual and team performance.

Working Days & Week-Off Policy

* Sunday working is mandatory due to peak customer enquiries and site-visit requirements.
* Weekly off will be provided on a weekday as per management allocation.
* Flexibility to work during marketing campaigns, festive periods, special sales drives, and other business requirements is expected.
* Working hours, attendance, leave, and other employment conditions will be governed by company policy.

Key Working Relationships

**Internal**

* Team Lead – Pre-Sales / Pre-Sales Manager
* Sales Managers and Field Sales Team
* Digital Marketing Team
* CRM Team / CRM Head
* Liaison Team, wherever required
* Other relevant departments as required for customer enquiry resolution

**External**

* Prospective Customers and Clients
* Channel Partners / Property Brokers, where applicable
* Other authorised external stakeholders, as required

Qualification & Experience

**Essential**

* Any graduate degree from a recognised university is preferred.
* 1–3 years of experience in real estate pre-sales, telecalling, inside sales, customer relationship management, or target-based customer acquisition is preferred.
* Experience in residential plot sales, plotted developments, land sales, or other property-related businesses will be an added advantage.
* Good verbal communication skills in Tamil are essential for handling local customers.
* Basic to good English communication skills for professional interactions and reporting.
* Ability to work towards assigned performance targets and manage regular customer follow-ups.

**Desirable**

* Postgraduate qualification such as an MBA in Sales, Marketing, or a related field.
* Experience handling high-volume customer enquiries and digital marketing leads.
* Familiarity with CRM systems, lead management tools, and sales MIS reporting.
* Experience coordinating site visits and supporting real estate sales conversions.
* Fresh graduates with strong communication skills and a willingness to work in a target-driven environment may be considered based on business requirements.

Functional Competencies

* Lead Management and Qualification
* Customer Relationship Management
* Real Estate Project Knowledge
* Lead Conversion and Site-Visit Coordination
* Communication, Persuasion and Objection Handling
* CRM and Technology Utilisation
* Reporting and Performance Metrics
* Follow-Up and Sales Pipeline Management
* Cross-Functional Coordination
* Target Achievement and Productivity Management

Behavioural Competencies

* Customer Focus
* Team Collaboration
* Emotional Intelligence
* Time Management and Prioritisation
* Adaptability and Initiative
* Accountability and Ownership
* Professionalism and Ethical Conduct
* Resilience and Target Orientation
* Attention to Detail
* Continuous Learning and Improvement

Pay: Up to ₹500,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Job Summary**

We at HCLTech seek to recruit experienced PreSales Architects to join our Hybrid Cloud Business Unit. In this role, you will join a skilled team of Solution Architects whose primary responsibility is to support our sales teams in developing best-in-class and innovative technology-centric solutions across the Data Center and Cloud portfolio. We are looking for candidates with proven experience in responding to RFP / RFIs, solution creation, client interactions and presentations, pricing, business case analysis, and deal lifecycle management.

  

Key expertise should include managed services, servers/storage/backup modernization, hyper-converged infrastructure, software-defined DC, private/public cloud automation, cloud assessment, cloud migration and transformation, cloud operations, FinOps, and a good understanding of PaaS and containers.

* To collaborate with the key stakeholders across the Hybrid Cloud practice and Business Development Executives within HCL Technologies to effectively lead the aligned pre-sales engagements to success
* Own and drive the RFP process, including due diligence, solution presentation, pricing creation, internal stakeholder discussions, SoW support, and proposal submission.

title: Presales Consultant Trainee
description:
**Job Title:** Pre\-Sales Consultant (Demo Engineer)

**About Skill\-Lync**

Skill\-Lync is a Y Combinator\-backed EdTech company offering industry\-aligned engineering and technology programs across Mechanical, Civil, Electrical, Electronics, and Computer Science domains. We help aspiring engineers bridge the gap between academics and industry through practical, job\-oriented learning. As one of the fastest\-growing YC\-backed startups, we're building a high\-performing sales team to connect learners with impactful upskilling opportunities.

**Role Overview**

As a Business Development Associate (BDA), you will play a key role in driving Skill\-Lync's growth by helping prospective learners make informed career decisions. You will engage with qualified leads, understand their learning and career goals, recommend the right programs, and guide them through the enrollment journey.

**Location:** Chennai

**Experience:** 0–2 Years (Freshers can apply)

**Employment Type:** Full\-Time

**Job Summary**

We are looking for enthusiastic Mechanical, Electrical, Electronics, Automobile, Mechatronics, or related engineering graduates to join our Pre\-Sales team. As a Pre\-Sales Consultant (Demo Engineer), you will conduct technical demo sessions, explain engineering concepts, guide learners on career opportunities, and support the sales team in converting prospective learners.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Conduct engaging live technical demo sessions for prospective learners.
* Explain engineering concepts using real\-world projects and industry applications.
* Demonstrate engineering software and technical workflows.
* Address learner queries related to Mechanical Design, CAD, CAE, CFD, Embedded Systems, Electric Vehicles, MATLAB \& Simulink, and related domains.
* Guide learners on career paths, industry trends, required technical skills, and portfolio development.
* Collaborate with Sales, Product, and Academic teams to improve learner experience.
* Track demo quality, learner satisfaction, attendance, and demo\-to\-enrollment conversion.

**Required Skills**

* Strong engineering fundamentals.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills.
* Ability to simplify complex technical concepts.
* Good interpersonal and problem\-solving skills.
* Passion for teaching, mentoring, and interacting with learners.
* Quick learner with adaptability to different learner backgrounds.

**Eligibility**

* B.E./B.Tech/M.E./M.Tech in Mechanical, Automobile, Electrical, Electronics, Mechatronics, Civil, Computer Science, or related disciplines.
* Freshers or candidates with up to 2 years of experience.
* Prior experience in technical training, demonstrations, or EdTech is an added advantage.Preferred Technical Knowledge
* CAD Design, GD\&T, Sheet Metal, BIW
* CAE (ANSYS, HyperMesh, FEA)
* CFD (ANSYS Fluent)
* Embedded Systems
* Electric Vehicle Technology
* MATLAB \& Simulink

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to work with one of India's leading Engineering EdTech companies.
* Continuous technical upskilling.
* Cross\-functional exposure with Sales, Product, and Academic teams.
* Performance\-based incentives.
* Clear career growth opportunities into Senior Demo Engineer, Technical Trainer, Product Specialist, Solutions Consultant, Pre\-Sales Manager, and Program Manager.

**How to Apply**

Interested candidates can DM me directly or send their resume to navinya.aikal@criodo.com with the subject line: "Pre\-sales Application – Your Name"

Pay: ₹360,000\.00 \- ₹1,845,246\.29 per year

Benefits:

* Commuter assistance
* Paid sick time
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: CMT - Domain Consultant
description:
About the role
  
As a Domain Consultant – Communications, Media \& Technology, you will make an impact by supporting the pre\-sales team in crafting compelling, market insight\-led proposals and bid responses across CMT sub\-sectors such as OTT, AdTech and telco BSS. You will be a valued member of the Business Development team and work collaboratively with presales leads, solution architects, account teams, and clients.
  
In this role, you will
  
Act as a trusted advisor to Sales and Solutioning teams, translating complex CMT industry trends (5G, OTT convergence, AdTech shifts) into actionable client\-facing insights and opportunity maps aligned to Cognizant Moment solutions.
  
Proactively identify, qualify and prioritise new business opportunities within CMT accounts by mapping industry trends, regulatory shifts and competitive dynamics to solution capabilities.
  
Partner with account teams to uncover cross\-sell and upsell opportunities within existing engagements, expanding Cognizant’s footprint.
  
Develop deep expertise in Cognizant Moment’s CX\-CRM and Digital Engagement platform solutions and articulate how they address CMT priorities such as subscriber growth, churn reduction, digital monetization and personalised omnichannel experiences.
  
Incubate emerging CMT offerings and proofs of concept, leading cross\-functional sprints and building business cases to secure internal investment for practice growth.
  
Work model
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Chennai, Bangalore or Hyderabad. Regardless of your working arrangement, we are here to support a healthy work\-life balance through our various wellbeing programs.
  
The working arrangements for this role are accurate as of the date of posting. This may change based on the project you're engaged in, as well as business and client requirements. Rest assured; we will always be clear about role expectations.
  
What you must have to be considered
  
Bachelor’s degree in engineering, preferably computer science or IT; MBA or relevant master’s preferred.
  
10–15\+ years of experience in business development, pre\-sales or consulting, with at least 5\+ years focused on business growth in the Communications, Media and Technology industry related to enterprise\-level Customer Data Platform solutions.
  
Working knowledge of monolithic as well as microservices application architecture (RESTful API, API integration, etc.).
  
Proven experience supporting RFx responses, client presentations and solution demonstrations.
  
Strong executive presence with excellent communication, storytelling and presentation skills.
  
These will help you succeed
  
Deep CMT industry fluency across 5G/telecom ecosystems, OTT and streaming, digital publishing, AdTech/MarTech, gaming and SaaS business models, with sub\-sector depth in Telecom, Media \& Entertainment or High\-Tech.
  
Ability to track and distil regulatory, technology and consumer\-behaviour shifts into actionable business insights and opportunity maps for clients.
  
Working knowledge of key CMT players, platform vendors, system integrators and emerging disruptors shaping the digital engagement space.
  
Technology awareness of SaaS mobile and web applications on AWS, GCP and Azure for CX\-CRM and Digital Engagement platforms (e.g., Salesforce, Mixpanel, Moengage, Webengage, Google Analytics, Adobe Experience Cloud or other Product Analytics tools).
  
Working knowledge of global and regional CMT regulations such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, ePrivacy Directive, CAN\-SPAM, TCPA and evolving AI governance frameworks.
  
We're excited to meet people who share our mission and can make an impact in a variety of ways. Don't hesitate to apply, even if you only meet the minimum requirements listed. Think about your transferable experiences and unique skills that make you stand out as someone who can bring new and exciting things to this role.

title: MLEU – Domain Consultant
description:
About the role
  
As a MLEU Domain Expert, you will make an impact by supporting the pre\-sales team in crafting compelling, market insight\-led proposals and bid responses across Manufacturing, Automotive, Logistics and Energy \& Utilities (MLEU), mapping client needs to Cognizant Moment digital engagement capabilities that communicate clear business value. You will be a valued member of the Business Development team and work collaboratively with pre\-sales leads, solution architects, and account teams, and clients.
  
In this role, you will
  
Act as a trusted domain advisor to pre\-sales, sales, and solution architecture teams, articulating the differentiated business value of Cognizant Moment digital engagement solutions across MLEU and mapping platform capabilities (CX\-CRM, CX\-CDP, Product Analytics, Digital Engagement) to sector priorities.
  
Proactively identify and qualify new business opportunities within MLEU accounts by translating Industry 4\.0, connected mobility, digital supply chain, and energy\-transition trends into actionable, client\-facing insights and points of view.
  
Support the end\-to\-end pre\-sales cycle (RFI, RFP, and RFQ responses, solution demonstrations, and executive presentations) with sector\-relevant win themes, value drivers, KPIs, and business cases tied to measurable ROI.
  
Serve as a subject matter expert on industry\-aligned solution capabilities, enabling sales, business development, and client teams through domain enablement sessions, reusable knowledge artefacts, and solution accelerators.
  
Sense emerging MLEU opportunities and build market and competitive intelligence, leading cross\-functional sprints and design\-thinking workshops to prototype new solution hypotheses and shape practice\-growth business cases.
  
Work model
  
At Cognizant, we strive to provide flexibility wherever possible. Based on this role's business requirements, this is a hybrid position requiring 3 days a week in a client or Cognizant office in Chennai, Bangalore, or Hyderabad.
